_doc: Foundational and peer-reviewed reference inventory for the hKCC framework.
Each entry mirrors the canonical PDF stored in ./references/ at repo root.
- DOI/year/title/journal extracted from each PDF's first page (auto + manual verify).
- pdf_path is relative to the repository root, joined at runtime to a resolved Path.
- tags drive the UI faceting on the Methodology page (Foundational/Methodology/...).
Adding a reference here automatically wires it through the seed loader.
